protocol.scope: Controlled replay from the artifact boundary through existing canonical generator, real MCP ranking/validation, existing selection and real finalization; no LLM agents rerun and no claim of full CAMEL ablation.
protocol.runtime_intervention: Remove telemetry reference/context/observations; retain exactly the same SBOM inventory, CTI report, candidates and operator policy.
protocol.before_after_validation: Compare rank-first proposal, native semantic status, operational status and actual post-validation recommendation. Ranking proposal is not an accepted or executed action.
protocol.generator_timing: Thin wrappers around the three unchanged upstream functions; preserve installed file hashes, outputs and input validation. Extra function-call/clock overhead included.
